
## Gene Expression Matrix

The expression matrix contains TPM values supplied by the upstream analysis. Gene identifiers and sample names retain their input values. The report provides a preview; complete results remain in the delivered data directory.

```{python}
#| label: pdf-matrix
#| output: asis
matrix = pd.read_csv(tpm_file, sep='\t', index_col=0)
metadata = pd.read_csv(meta_file) if meta_file else None
if metadata is not None:
    from bioreport.utils.pdf_results import ordered_samples
    columns = ordered_samples(metadata, matrix.columns)
else:
    columns = list(matrix.columns)
from bioreport.utils.pdf_results import expression_preview
shown = expression_preview(matrix, columns[:pdf_settings.get('matrix_columns', 6)]).reset_index()
shown = shown.rename(columns={shown.columns[0]: 'Gene ID'})
shown = gene_columns(apply_gene_annotation(shown, project_info))
preview(shown, tpm_file, limit=pdf_settings.get('matrix_rows', 8), caption='TPM Expression Matrix Preview', order_note='mean TPM across all samples, descending')
display_result_ai('rna.results.matrix__table')
typst_note(f"Body shows {min(len(columns), pdf_settings.get('matrix_columns', 6))} / {len(matrix.columns)} sample columns.")
if not project_info.get('input_files', {}).get('gene_annotation_file'):
    typst_note('No gene annotation file supplied. The expression matrix retains original Gene IDs and omits Gene Symbol.')
```
